title: SendGrid Web API v2 mail send migration
description: The official SendGrid migration guide identifies the legacy v2 mail-send endpoint /api/mail.send.json and maps it to the v3 /v3/mail/send endpoint. The source provides migration guidance but does not state a universal shutdown date.
oldBehavior: The integration calls the legacy SendGrid Web API v2 mail-send endpoint.
newBehavior: The integration calls the documented SendGrid v3 mail-send endpoint.
migrationInstructions: Replace a direct static /api/mail.send.json endpoint literal with /v3/mail/send.
Review authentication, payload shape, response handling, and dynamic URL construction separately.

evidenceSources.summary: The official SendGrid migration guide maps the legacy v2 mail-send endpoint to the v3 mail-send endpoint.

review.notes: Approved only for the exact legacy mail-send endpoint and documented v3 replacement. No universal shutdown date is inferred.

assumptions: The source provides migration guidance but does not establish a universal shutdown date.
Only direct static endpoint literals are eligible for the deterministic transformation; payload and response semantics remain review-only.
